#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Export each demo PR branch and run its own tests with plain pytest.
repo="$1"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
for b in $(git -C "$repo" branch --format='%(refname:short)' | grep '^pr/'); do
  d="$tmp/${b#pr/}"
  mkdir -p "$d"
  git -C "$repo" archive "$b" | tar -x -C "$d"
  out="$(cd "$d" && uv run --no-project --with pytest python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1)"
  code=$?
  echo "$b exit=$code :: $(echo "$out" | tail -1)"
done
echo "trees in $tmp"

"""Export each demo PR branch and run its own tests with plain pytest."""

import io
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path(sys.argv[1])
branches = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "branch", "--format=%(refname:short)"],
                          capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.split()
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="linus-branches-"))
for b in sorted(x for x in branches if x.startswith("pr/")):
    d = tmp / b.split("/")[1]
    d.mkdir()
    data = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "archive", b], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
    tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data)).extractall(d)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider"],
                       cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
    last = (r.stdout.strip().splitlines() or [""])[-1]
    print(f"{b} exit={r.returncode} :: {last}")
print("trees in", tmp)

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

          "| JEV $ | OpenAI tokens | Agent s/PR | Run |\n"
          "|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|\n")
# Rows written before per-PR dollar cost was tracked keep the original columns.


def score(summary: dict, expected: dict) -> dict:
    rows = []
    for n, exp in sorted(expected.items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])):
        verdicts = summary["verdicts"]
        got = verdicts.get(int(n)) or verdicts.get(str(n))
        rows.append({"pr": int(n), "author": got["author"], "expected": exp["verdict"],
                     "got": got["verdict"], "ok": got["verdict"] == exp["verdict"],
                     "why_expected": exp["why"], "reason": got["reason"]})
    good = [r for r in rows if r["expected"] == "pay"]
    bad = [r for r in rows if r["expected"] == "reject"]
    false_pay = [r["pr"] for r in bad if r["got"] == "pay"]
    missed = [r["pr"] for r in good if r["got"] == "reject"]
    flagged = [r["pr"] for r in rows if r["got"] == "flag"]
    cost = summary["cost"]
    return {
        "run_id": summary["run_id"],
        "accuracy": sum(r["ok"] for r in rows) / len(rows),
        "false_pay_rate": len(false_pay) / len(bad) if bad else 0.0,
        "missed_good_rate": len(missed) / len(good) if good else 0.0,
        "human_flag_rate": len(flagged) / len(rows),
        "false_pay": false_pay, "missed_good": missed, "flagged": flagged,
        "jev_usd": cost["jev_usd"], "openai_tokens": cost["openai_tokens"],
        "openai_usd": cost.get("openai_usd"), "usd_per_pr": cost.get("usd_per_pr"),
        "seconds_per_pr": cost["pr_seconds"] / max(cost["prs"], 1),
        "rows": rows,

"""What humans see: live console output during a close, and report.md after."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

from rich.console import Console
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.table import Table

STYLE = {"pay": ("PAY", "bold green"), "reject": ("REJECT", "bold red"), "flag": ("FLAG", "bold yellow")}


def _money(amount: float, currency: str) -> str:
    return f"${amount:,.2f}" if currency == "USD" else f"{amount:,.2f} {currency}"


class ConsoleUI:
    def __init__(self, console: Console) -> None:
        self.c = console

    def plan(self, close, pulls) -> None:
        budget = " + ".join(_money(v, k) for k, v in close.policy.budget.items())
        title = "Resuming" if close.resumed else "Month-end close"
        self.c.print(Panel.fit(
            f"[bold]{close.source.name}[/]  period {close.source.period}  ·  {len(pulls)} PRs  ·  pool {budget}\n"
            f"run [cyan]{close.run_id}[/]",
            title=f"Linus · {title}", border_style="cyan"))

    def item(self, pr, verdict: str | None, reason: str, data: dict, resumed: bool = False,
             late: bool = False) -> None:
        label, style = STYLE.get(verdict or "", ("?", "white"))
        tag = " [dim](checkpoint)[/]" if resumed else (" [dim](anti-gaming)[/]" if late else "")
        self.c.print(f"  #{pr.number}  {pr.author:<12} [{style}]{label:<6}[/]  {reason}{tag}")

    def crash(self, run_id: str, processed: int) -> None:
        self.c.print(f"\n[bold red]Simulated crash (kill -9) after {processed} PRs.[/] "
                     f"State is saved per PR. Resume with: [bold]linus close --resume {run_id}[/]")

    def done(self, summary: dict) -> None:
        table = Table(title="Proposed payouts" if summary["status"] == "proposed" else "Payouts (halted)")
        table.add_column("contributor")
        table.add_column("PRs")
        for a in summary["allocations"]:
            table.add_column(a["currency"], justify="right")
        authors = sorted({c for a in summary["allocations"] for c in a["payouts"]})
        prs_by_author: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for n, v in summary["verdicts"].items():
            if v["verdict"] == "pay":
                prs_by_author.setdefault(v["author"], []).append(f"#{n}")
        for who in authors:
            table.add_row(who, " ".join(prs_by_author.get(who, [])),
                          *[_money(a["payouts"].get(who, 0), a["currency"]) for a in summary["allocations"]])
        if any(a["rollover"] for a in summary["allocations"]):
            table.add_row("[dim]rollover[/]", "", *[_money(a["rollover"], a["currency"])
                                                    for a in summary["allocations"]])
        self.c.print()
        self.c.print(table)
        counts = {k: sum(1 for v in summary["verdicts"].values() if v["verdict"] == k)
                  for k in ("pay", "reject", "flag")}
        cost = summary["cost"]
        self.c.print(f"  verdicts: [green]{counts['pay']} pay[/] · [red]{counts['reject']} reject[/] · "
                     f"[yellow]{counts['flag']} flag[/]")
        openai_usd = f"${cost['openai_usd']:.4f}" if cost.get("openai_usd") is not None else "price unknown"
        self.c.print(f"  cost: JEV {cost['jev_tokens']:,} tokens (${cost['jev_usd']:.5f}) · "
                     f"OpenAI {cost['openai_tokens']:,} tokens ({cost['openai_model']}, {openai_usd}) · "
                     f"[bold]${cost.get('usd_per_pr', 0):.4f} per PR[/] · {cost['pr_seconds']:.0f}s of agent time")
        if summary["problems"]:
            self.c.print("[bold red]  invariants failed, nothing will be paid:[/]")
            for p in summary["problems"]:
                self.c.print(f"    - {p}")
        else:
            self.c.print("  invariants: [green]all hold[/] (sum = budget, caps, minimums, "
                         "verified receipts, no double pay)")
        self.c.print(f"  report: {summary['run_dir']}/report.md")
        if summary.get("trace_id"):
            self.c.print(f"  neatlogs trace: {summary['trace_id']}  (neatlogs trace get {summary['trace_id']})")
        if summary["status"] == "proposed":
            self.c.print(f"  next: review, then [bold]linus approve {summary['run_id']}[/]")


def markdown(summary: dict) -> str:
    run_dir = Path(summary["run_dir"])
    lines = [
        f"# Linus close: {summary['repo']} · {summary['period']}",
        "",
        f"Run `{summary['run_id']}` · status **{summary['status']}**"
        + (f" · neatlogs trace `{summary['trace_id']}`" if summary.get("trace_id") else ""),
        "",
        "## Payouts",
        "",
    ]
    currencies = [a["currency"] for a in summary["allocations"]]
    lines.append("| Contributor | " + " | ".join(currencies) + " |")
    lines.append("|---|" + "---:|" * len(currencies))
    authors = sorted({c for a in summary["allocations"] for c in a["payouts"]})
    for who in authors:
        lines.append(f"| {who} | " + " | ".join(_money(a["payouts"].get(who, 0), a["currency"])
                                                for a in summary["allocations"]) + " |")
    rollover = [a for a in summary["allocations"] if a["rollover"]]
    if rollover:
        lines.append("| _rollover to next month_ | " + " | ".join(
            _money(a["rollover"], a["currency"]) for a in summary["allocations"]) + " |")
    lines += ["", "## Every PR", "", "| PR | Author | Verdict | Why | Points |", "|---|---|---|---|---:|"]
    for n, v in sorted(summary["verdicts"].items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])):
        pts = f"{v['points']:g}" if v.get("points") else ""
        lines.append(f"| #{n} | {v['author']} | {v['verdict']} | {v['reason']} | {pts} |")

    lines += ["", "## Evidence", ""]
    for n in sorted(summary["verdicts"], key=int):
        path = run_dir / "receipts" / f"pr-{n}.json"
        if not path.exists():
            continue
        r = json.loads(path.read_text())
        lines.append(f"### #{n} {r['pr']['title']} ({r['pr']['author']})")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"- Verdict: **{r['verdict']}**: {r['reason']}")
        gate = (r.get("gate") or {}).get("answers") or {}
        if gate:
            bits = [f"{k} p={v['noul']:.2f}" for k, v in gate.items() if "noul" in v]
            bits += [f"{k} level {max(v['probabilities'], key=lambda x: v['probabilities'][x])} "
                     f"(conf {v['confidence']:.2f})" for k, v in gate.items() if "score" in v]
            lines.append(f"- JEV ({r['gate'].get('jev_model', '')}): " + ", ".join(bits))
        if r.get("signals", {}).get("injection_hits"):
            lines.append(f"- Injection text found: `{r['signals']['injection_hits'][0][:120]}`")
        if r.get("signals", {}).get("removed_tests"):
            lines.append(f"- Tests removed by the PR: {', '.join(r['signals']['removed_tests'])}")
        if r.get("oracle"):
            o = r["oracle"]
            tries = ", ".join(f"try {a['attempt']}: base {a['base_outcome']}" for a in o["attempts"])
            lines.append(f"- Oracle for #{o['issue']}: `{o['test_path']}` sha256 `{(o['test_sha256'] or '')[:12]}` "
                         f"({len(o.get('cases') or [])} cases; {tries})")
            for c in o.get("dropped") or []:
                lines.append(f"  - JEV dropped generated case `{c['call']} == {c['expected']}` "
                             f"(consistent with issue p={c['jev']:.2f})")
        for run in (r.get("verification") or {}).get("runs", []):
            lines.append(f"- Sandbox `{run['label']}`: {run['outcome']} "
                         f"({run['passed']} passed, {run['failed']} failed, {run['duration_s']}s)")
        if r.get("anti_gaming"):
            lines.append(f"- Anti-gaming: similarity {r['anti_gaming']['similarity']:.0%} to #{r['anti_gaming']['winner']}")
        if r.get("points"):
            lines.append(f"- Points: {r['points']['explanation']}")
        lines.append(f"- Receipt: `receipts/pr-{n}.json`")
        lines.append("")

    cost = summary["cost"]
    lines += [
        "## Cost", "",
        f"- JEV: {cost['jev_tokens']:,} input tokens, ${cost['jev_usd']:.5f}",
        f"- OpenAI ({cost['openai_model']}): {cost['openai_tokens']:,} tokens"
        + (f", ${cost['openai_usd']:.4f}" if cost.get("openai_usd") is not None else ""),
        f"- Model cost per PR: ${cost.get('usd_per_pr', 0):.4f}",
        f"- Agent time: {cost['pr_seconds']:.0f}s across {cost['prs']} PRs",
        "",
        "## Invariants", "",
    ]
    if summary["problems"]:
        lines += [f"- FAILED: {p}" for p in summary["problems"]]
    else:
        lines.append("- All hold: payouts + rollover = budget, per-contributor cap, minimum payout, "
                     "every payout backed by a verified receipt, nobody paid twice, no excluded authors.")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

"""What humans see: live console output during a close, and report.md after."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

from rich.console import Console
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.table import Table

STYLE = {"pay": ("PAY", "bold green"), "reject": ("REJECT", "bold red"), "flag": ("FLAG", "bold yellow")}


def _money(amount: float, currency: str) -> str:
    return f"${amount:,.2f}" if currency == "USD" else f"{amount:,.2f} {currency}"


class ConsoleUI:
    def __init__(self, console: Console) -> None:
        self.c = console

    def plan(self, close, pulls) -> None:
        budget = " + ".join(_money(v, k) for k, v in close.policy.budget.items())
        title = "Resuming" if close.resumed else "Month-end close"
        self.c.print(Panel.fit(
            f"[bold]{close.source.name}[/]  period {close.source.period}  ·  {len(pulls)} PRs  ·  pool {budget}\n"
            f"run [cyan]{close.run_id}[/]",
            title=f"Linus · {title}", border_style="cyan"))

    def item(self, pr, verdict: str | None, reason: str, data: dict, resumed: bool = False,
             late: bool = False) -> None:
        label, style = STYLE.get(verdict or "", ("?", "white"))
        tag = " [dim](checkpoint)[/]" if resumed else (" [dim](anti-gaming)[/]" if late else "")
        self.c.print(f"  #{pr.number}  {pr.author:<12} [{style}]{label:<6}[/]  {reason}{tag}")

    def crash(self, run_id: str, processed: int) -> None:
        self.c.print(f"\n[bold red]Simulated crash (kill -9) after {processed} PRs.[/] "
                     f"State is saved per PR. Resume with: [bold]uv run linus close --resume {run_id}[/]")

    def done(self, summary: dict) -> None:
        table = Table(title="Proposed payouts" if summary["status"] == "proposed" else "Payouts (halted)")
        table.add_column("contributor")
        table.add_column("PRs")
        for a in summary["allocations"]:
            table.add_column(a["currency"], justify="right")
        authors = sorted({c for a in summary["allocations"] for c in a["payouts"]})
        prs_by_author: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for n, v in summary["verdicts"].items():
            if v["verdict"] == "pay":
                prs_by_author.setdefault(v["author"], []).append(f"#{n}")
        for who in authors:
            table.add_row(who, " ".join(prs_by_author.get(who, [])),
                          *[_money(a["payouts"].get(who, 0), a["currency"]) for a in summary["allocations"]])
        if any(a["rollover"] for a in summary["allocations"]):
            table.add_row("[dim]rollover[/]", "", *[_money(a["rollover"], a["currency"])
                                                    for a in summary["allocations"]])
        self.c.print()
        self.c.print(table)
        counts = {k: sum(1 for v in summary["verdicts"].values() if v["verdict"] == k)
                  for k in ("pay", "reject", "flag")}
        cost = summary["cost"]
        self.c.print(f"  verdicts: [green]{counts['pay']} pay[/] · [red]{counts['reject']} reject[/] · "
                     f"[yellow]{counts['flag']} flag[/]")
        openai_usd = f"${cost['openai_usd']:.4f}" if cost.get("openai_usd") is not None else "price unknown"
        self.c.print(f"  cost: JEV {cost['jev_tokens']:,} tokens (${cost['jev_usd']:.5f}) · "
                     f"OpenAI {cost['openai_tokens']:,} tokens ({cost['openai_model']}, {openai_usd}) · "
                     f"[bold]${cost.get('usd_per_pr', 0):.4f} per PR[/] · {cost['pr_seconds']:.0f}s of agent time")
        if summary["problems"]:
            self.c.print("[bold red]  invariants failed, nothing will be paid:[/]")
            for p in summary["problems"]:
                self.c.print(f"    - {p}")
        else:
            self.c.print("  invariants: [green]all hold[/] (sum = budget, caps, minimums, "
                         "verified receipts, no double pay)")
        self.c.print(f"  report: {summary['run_dir']}/report.md")
        if summary.get("trace_id"):
            self.c.print(f"  neatlogs trace: {summary['trace_id']}  (neatlogs trace get {summary['trace_id']})")
        if summary["status"] == "proposed":
            self.c.print(f"  next: review, then [bold]uv run linus approve{summary['run_id']}[/]")


def markdown(summary: dict) -> str:
    run_dir = Path(summary["run_dir"])
    lines = [
        f"# Linus close: {summary['repo']} · {summary['period']}",
        "",
        f"Run `{summary['run_id']}` · status **{summary['status']}**"
        + (f" · neatlogs trace `{summary['trace_id']}`" if summary.get("trace_id") else ""),
        "",
        "## Payouts",
        "",
    ]
    currencies = [a["currency"] for a in summary["allocations"]]
    lines.append("| Contributor | " + " | ".join(currencies) + " |")
    lines.append("|---|" + "---:|" * len(currencies))
    authors = sorted({c for a in summary["allocations"] for c in a["payouts"]})
    for who in authors:
        lines.append(f"| {who} | " + " | ".join(_money(a["payouts"].get(who, 0), a["currency"])
                                                for a in summary["allocations"]) + " |")
    rollover = [a for a in summary["allocations"] if a["rollover"]]
    if rollover:
        lines.append("| _rollover to next month_ | " + " | ".join(
            _money(a["rollover"], a["currency"]) for a in summary["allocations"]) + " |")
    lines += ["", "## Every PR", "", "| PR | Author | Verdict | Why | Points |", "|---|---|---|---|---:|"]
    for n, v in sorted(summary["verdicts"].items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])):
        pts = f"{v['points']:g}" if v.get("points") else ""
        lines.append(f"| #{n} | {v['author']} | {v['verdict']} | {v['reason']} | {pts} |")

    lines += ["", "## Evidence", ""]
    for n in sorted(summary["verdicts"], key=int):
        path = run_dir / "receipts" / f"pr-{n}.json"
        if not path.exists():
            continue
        r = json.loads(path.read_text())
        lines.append(f"### #{n} {r['pr']['title']} ({r['pr']['author']})")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"- Verdict: **{r['verdict']}**: {r['reason']}")
        gate = (r.get("gate") or {}).get("answers") or {}
        if gate:
            bits = [f"{k} p={v['noul']:.2f}" for k, v in gate.items() if "noul" in v]
            bits += [f"{k} level {max(v['probabilities'], key=lambda x: v['probabilities'][x])} "
                     f"(conf {v['confidence']:.2f})" for k, v in gate.items() if "score" in v]
            lines.append(f"- JEV ({r['gate'].get('jev_model', '')}): " + ", ".join(bits))
        if r.get("signals", {}).get("injection_hits"):
            lines.append(f"- Injection text found: `{r['signals']['injection_hits'][0][:120]}`")
        if r.get("signals", {}).get("removed_tests"):
            lines.append(f"- Tests removed by the PR: {', '.join(r['signals']['removed_tests'])}")
        if r.get("oracle"):
            o = r["oracle"]
            tries = ", ".join(f"try {a['attempt']}: base {a['base_outcome']}" for a in o["attempts"])
            lines.append(f"- Oracle for #{o['issue']}: `{o['test_path']}` sha256 `{(o['test_sha256'] or '')[:12]}` "
                         f"({len(o.get('cases') or [])} cases; {tries})")
            for c in o.get("dropped") or []:
                lines.append(f"  - JEV dropped generated case `{c['call']} == {c['expected']}` "
                             f"(consistent with issue p={c['jev']:.2f})")
        for run in (r.get("verification") or {}).get("runs", []):
            lines.append(f"- Sandbox `{run['label']}`: {run['outcome']} "
                         f"({run['passed']} passed, {run['failed']} failed, {run['duration_s']}s)")
        if r.get("anti_gaming"):
            lines.append(f"- Anti-gaming: similarity {r['anti_gaming']['similarity']:.0%} to #{r['anti_gaming']['winner']}")
        if r.get("points"):
            lines.append(f"- Points: {r['points']['explanation']}")
        lines.append(f"- Receipt: `receipts/pr-{n}.json`")
        lines.append("")

    cost = summary["cost"]
    lines += [
        "## Cost", "",
        f"- JEV: {cost['jev_tokens']:,} input tokens, ${cost['jev_usd']:.5f}",
        f"- OpenAI ({cost['openai_model']}): {cost['openai_tokens']:,} tokens"
        + (f", ${cost['openai_usd']:.4f}" if cost.get("openai_usd") is not None else ""),

        f"- Agent time: {cost['pr_seconds']:.0f}s across {cost['prs']} PRs",
        "",
        "## Invariants", "",
    ]
    if summary["problems"]:
        lines += [f"- FAILED: {p}" for p in summary["problems"]]
    else:
        lines.append("- All hold: payouts + rollover = budget, per-contributor cap, minimum payout, "

# Linus at neatHack

## Problem

Open-source companies want outside contributors and will pay bounties, but
money attracts AI slop: PRs that pass CI, look plausible and fix nothing. curl
ended its bug bounty in January 2026 for exactly this reason. Maintainers can't
verify every PR by hand, and splitting a monthly budget fairly is manual and
contentious.

## What Linus does

An agent that runs the month-end close for a bounty pool: it verifies every PR
in the period with reproducible evidence, rejects or flags what it can't prove,
allocates a fixed budget with a deterministic formula and hard invariants, and
writes a tamper-evident ledger for the maintainer to approve.

## Team

- Varun ([@VARUN3WARE](https://github.com/VARUN3WARE))

## Tech stack

- Python 3.10+, uv, Typer, Rich, SQLite
- JEV (TypeSafe System One) for every cheap, typed decision
- OpenAI `gpt-5.4-mini` only for generating reproduction test cases
- Docker sandbox (no network, read-only mounts) for running untrusted PR code
- neatlogs for tracing, Entire for coding-agent checkpoints, cfo.ai for the
  business plan

## Partner tool evidence

| Tool | How we use it | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| neatlogs | One trace per close: workflow span, agent span per PR, JEV calls as LLM spans with tokens and cost, auto-captured OpenAI calls, Docker runs as tool spans, anti-gaming and invariant guardrails | Workflow `linus`. Cold v4 run: trace `d471472b34e4ee099f72c18f53fde268`. _Add dashboard screenshots of the v2 (failure) and v4 (fixed) runs._ |
| Entire | Enabled for the coding agent in this repo (`.entire/`, hooks in `.claude/settings.json`) | `entire checkpoint list`. _The first build session started before Entire was installed, so checkpoints begin with later sessions._ |
| cfo.ai | Pricing, cost per verified PR, margins, runway | _Business plan link pending; inputs below_ |
| JEV | Gates, oracle audit, scoring levels | Every receipt records JEV's answers and model version (`jev-1.13.0`) |

## Build log

### 2026-10-11

- Scaffold: config, neatlogs tracing, `linus doctor`. Read the JEV docs end to
  end: JEV is a decision model (Noul / Choice / Score), not a chat model, so the
  design became "JEV decides, OpenAI generates, tests prove, code pays".
- Pipeline: demo month (11 PRs, 6 attacks, CI green on all), JEV gates, oracle
  per issue, Docker sandbox, anti-gaming, allocation with invariants, receipts,
  hash-chained ledger, SQLite checkpoints, evals.
- **v1:** every verdict correct, then crashed while settling: JEV score keys came
  back as strings after a JSON round-trip. Fixed, then `linus close --resume
  latest` finished the run from per-PR checkpoints with zero repeated API calls.
- Payout calibration: v1's point table had 3x gaps between adjacent difficulty
  levels, so JEV's trivial-vs-small uncertainty became 3x payout differences
  for near-identical one-line fixes. Smoothed the table.
- Allocation bug found by a unit check: with a 30% cap, a 1-point contributor
  received $600 because capped excess was redistributed. Excess now rolls over.
- **v2 (cold oracles):** rejected a correct PR. The generated oracle expected
  `slugify("Café & Tea / Coffee") == "caf--tea-coffee"`, contradicting the
  issue's single-dash rule. Missed-good 20%.
- **v3:** JEV audits every generated case against the issue (drops that case at
  p=0.07, keeps the correct one at p=0.87). Exposed a rendering bug: expected
  values rendered as code (`== hello-world`), so the oracle "reproduced" the
  bug by crashing with NameError.
- **v4:** expected values rendered from JSON with repr(); an oracle only counts
  if it fails on base for a real reason, not NameError/ImportError/SyntaxError.
  100% accuracy, 0% false-pay, 0% missed-good on 5 consecutive cold runs.
- Sandbox/JEV conflict routing: when the oracle says "not fixed" but every
  cheap signal says "honest, complete fix", flag for a human instead of
  rejecting.
- Receipts re-verify with no LLM calls (`linus receipt`); ledger edits are
  detected (`linus ledger`); re-running an approved month halts on the
  double-pay invariant.

## Eval scorecard

See [`evals/SCORECARD.md`](evals/SCORECARD.md). Every row is a real run against
the demo month; ground truth is in `expected.json`, which the agent never sees.

| Metric | v1 | v2 | v3 | v4 (5 cold runs) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accuracy | 100% | 91% | 91% | 100% |
| False-pay rate | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% |
| Missed-good rate | 0% | 20% | 20% | 0% |
| Human-flag rate | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% |
| Model cost per PR | n/a | n/a | n/a | $0.0010 |

## Business plan inputs for cfo.ai

Measured (demo month, cold runs):
- Model cost per PR: **$0.0010** (JEV ~$0.00006, OpenAI ~$0.0009).
- Agent time per PR: ~2.5 s, plus sandbox runs of ~1 s each.

Assumptions to model (not measured yet):
- Real repositories send more context per oracle: model cost $0.01 to $0.05 per PR.
- Hosted sandbox compute: $0.002 to $0.01 per PR.
- Pricing options: a percentage of the pool processed (Algora reportedly
  charges 20%; verify before citing), or flat tiers (for example $49/month for
  one repo up to 100 PRs, $199/month for five repos).
- Scenarios: base and growth customer counts, team cost, runway.

## Demo

- Video: _pending_
- `make judge`: builds the sandbox, runs unit tests, runs the close on the demo
  month and scores it.

## Known limitations

- The demo month is small and self-made; it shows the mechanisms, not
  generalization.
- Python + pytest projects only.
- PRs come from a local git repo plus a fixture; the read-only GitHub source is
  not built yet.
- Linus proposes payouts; it does not move money.

## Next steps

- Read-only GitHub source and a backtest on a real repository's past month.
- A red-team agent that writes new attack PRs; misses become eval cases.
- Credit for reviews and issue reproductions, not just code.

## Submission checklist

- [ ] Web check-in done, team confirmed
- [x] Public repo with hackathon-period commits
- [ ] neatlogs traces: before and after screenshots
- [ ] Entire checkpoints attached to commits
- [ ] cfo.ai business plan included
- [x] Failure recovery shown in a real run (v1 crash, resumed from checkpoints)
- [ ] Demo video, 3 minutes or less
- [ ] Building-in-public posts tagged #neatHack
- [ ] X quote post published, Oct 12, 7:00 to 11:55 PM IST
